source.title: 22 registry remotes from jayniebingyu-cyber are unreachable for MCP clients (410, 502, 503)
source.body:
These entries in the official MCP registry did not answer an MCP `initialize` on 2026-10-26 from South Korea (checked twice, a few hours apart):

- `com.goaimoat/ai-visibility` → `https://mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 503
- `com.goaimoat/brand-intel-memory` → `https://memory.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/claim-verifier` → `https://verifier.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/company-intel` → `https://company.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/cross-border-profit` → `https://profit.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/cross-border-tax` → `https://tax.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/decision-maker-lookup` → `https://contacts.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 410
- `com.goaimoat/email-person-lookup` → `https://emaillookup.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/export-compliance` → `https://compliance.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/google-search` → `https://search.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/hot-topics` → `https://hot.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/market-intel-brief` → `https://intel.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/outreach-tracker` → `https://tracker.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/pricing-strategy` → `https://pricing.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/product-selection` → `https://selection.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/returns-refund-management` → `https://returns.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/review-intelligence` → `https://reviewintel.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/social-media-strategy` → `https://social.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/supplier-sourcing` → `https://supplier.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/tiktok-shop` → `https://tiktok.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/web-scrape` → `https://scrape.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502
- `com.goaimoat/xiaohongshu-products` → `https://xhs.mcp.goaimoat.com/mcp`: HTTP 502

What the codes mean here:
- 410: it answers HTTP 410 (Gone).
- 502: it answers HTTP 502 (Bad Gateway): the proxy in front is up but the server behind it is not answering.
- 503: it answers HTTP 503 (Service Unavailable).

Clients that install from the registry cannot connect to them. If they moved, a new registry version with the current URL fixes discovery; if they are retired, the entries can be marked deleted.

(The entries point at 3 of your repositories; this one issue covers them all: jayniebingyu-cyber/goaimoat-ai-visibility-mcp, jayniebingyu-cyber/goaimoat-mcp, jayniebingyu-cyber/hot-topics-mcp.)

Found by an MCP liveness probe (one vantage, South Korea); the record is in https://witan.markets/market/datasets/mcp-server-liveness. Happy to re-test after a change.
